description: Monthly projection uses 7-day rolling average — projected_monthly_usd equals (sum_of_daily_totals / 7) × 30.44
property: Property 8: For any set of daily cost totals over the last 7 days, the projected_monthly_usd SHALL equal (sum_of_daily_totals / 7) × 30.44, and daily_average_usd SHALL equal sum_of_daily_totals / 7
